verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API with comprehensive programmatic access to all resources, plus API tokens meant for 'other tools and automation'. Together these let it be driven headlessly without the Admin UI, and the Docker-based self-hosting path makes it plausible to run in pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI-specific integration docs or examples (e.g. pipeline recipes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
